title: He Claimed Angel. He Was Mafia.
title_variations: The Biggest Bluff In Mafia History
hook: He said he saved Ryan. He was lying.
description: Moxie Marlinspike claims to be the angel during a heated Mafia trial with Palmer Luckey, Sam Altman, and tech legends watching. One of the boldest lies in the game.
call_to_action: Would you have believed him? Comment below.

title: The Mafia Won. Everyone's Shocked.
title_variations: They Voted Him Out And Still Lost
Final Vote Chaos At Founders Fund
hook: The mafia wins. Nobody saw it coming.
description: The final vote of the game ends in chaos as Moxie is killed — but the mafia still wins. Watch the moment the table realizes they've been outplayed.
call_to_action: Who had the best read? Drop your guess.

title: Sam Altman Couldn't Believe It
title_variations: I Can Never Trust You Again
hook: Sam Altman just found out he got played.
description: After the mafia reveal, the table erupts in disbelief. Sam Altman and the other players realize Moxie deceived them for the entire game.
call_to_action: Tag someone who'd fall for this bluff.

title: Unanimous Vote. Electric Chair.
description: Josie Zayner defends herself on trial but gets a unanimous vote. The narrator sends her off with one of the most dramatic executions of the night.
call_to_action: Was this the right vote? Tell us.

title: Palmer Got Stoned Over A Book Reference
hook: Palmer Luckey died over a short story debate.
description: Palmer Luckey is executed by stoning in the tradition of Shirley Jackson's The Lottery — then the table argues about whether anyone actually read it in school.
call_to_action: Did you read The Lottery? Be honest.

title: Final Trial. He Still Claims Angel.
title_variations: The Most Convincing Liar At The Table
hook: Three rounds in and nobody has killed him.
description: The game-ending trial pits Moxie against Trey as Moxie delivers a masterclass defense claiming he's the angel. The tension is unreal.
call_to_action: Angel or mafia? What would you vote?

title: Found In Five Shipping Containers
hook: They found him in five shipping containers.
description: The narrator announces Ryan Petersen's death in the most absurd way possible — pieces found across five separate shipping containers. Peak Mafia comedy.

title: Sam Altman Goes Unhinged Tonight
title_variations: Tech Legends Trash Talk Before Mafia
Pro Poker Player vs Deal Negotiator
hook: Sam Altman said he's going unhinged tonight.
description: Before the first card is dealt, tech industry legends trash-talk about lying, winning, and strategy. Sam Altman, poker pros, and VCs set the stage.
call_to_action: Follow for the full game breakdown.

title: Guns Would Solve The Mafia Problem
description: During the rules explanation, the table derails into a hilarious Second Amendment debate about whether armed townspeople would end the mafia problem.
call_to_action: Best rules explanation fail? Share yours.

title: Why Is Moxie Still Alive?
title_variations: The Sus That Survived Every Round
hook: He's never been on trial. That's the problem.
description: Late in the game, players finally ask the obvious question — how has Moxie survived every round while claiming to be the angel? Paranoia hits peak levels.
call_to_action: When did you clock him as mafia?
